reason: No topic-post rule changes its light value from 70% to 30%. Every original 70% rule keeps 70% as the light argument (common/base/topic-post.scss:289-290, 298-299; desktop/topic-post.scss:677-679, 697-698; mobile/topic-post.scss:987-988). The real inversion goes the other way: desktop/topic-post.scss:619-620 changes the light value from 30% to 70%, which makes the text lighter, not darker.
